words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我想买一瓶矿泉水。(Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì píng kuàngquánshuǐ.) — I want to buy a bottle of mineral water.
这家店卖新鲜的水果。(Zhè jiā diàn mài xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ.) — This shop sells fresh fruit.
我没有钱，不能买这本书。(Wǒ méiyǒu qián, bùnéng mǎi zhè běn shū.) — I have no money; I can't buy this book.
这个西瓜二十块钱。(Zhè gè xīguā èrshí kuài qián.) — This watermelon is twenty yuan.
总共是一百五十元。(Zǒnggòng shì yì bǎi wǔshí yuán.) — The total is one hundred fifty yuan.
这个书包多少钱？(Zhè gè shūbāo duōshao qián?) — How much is this backpack?
太贵了，可以便宜一点儿吗？(Tài guì le, kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr ma?) — Too expensive, can you make it a bit cheaper?
网上的价格通常更便宜。(Wǎngshang de jiàgé tōngcháng gèng piányi.) — Online prices are usually cheaper.
你在超市买了什么东西？(Nǐ zài chāoshì mǎi le shénme dōngxi?) — What things did you buy at the supermarket?
学校附近有很多文具商店。(Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō wénjù shāngdiàn.) — There are many stationery shops near the school.
我们去超市买点日常用品。(Wǒmen qù chāoshì mǎi diǎn rìcháng yòngpǐn.) — Let's go to the supermarket to buy daily necessities.
你最喜欢什么颜色？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè?) — What color do you like most?
在中国文化中，红色代表吉利。(Zài Zhōngguó wénhuà zhōng, hóngsè dàibiǎo jílì.) — In Chinese culture, red represents good fortune.
他穿了一件白色的衬衫。(Tā chuān le yí jiàn báisè de chènshān.) — He wore a white shirt.
我买了一双黑色的运动鞋。(Wǒ mǎi le yì shuāng hēisè de yùndòngxié.) — I bought a pair of black sneakers.
今天的天空是深蓝色的。(Jīntiān de tiānkōng shì shēnlánsè de.) — Today's sky is deep blue.
秋天树叶变成了黄色。(Qiūtiān shùyè biàn chéng le huángsè.) — In autumn the tree leaves turn yellow.
多看绿色植物对眼睛好。(Duō kàn lǜsè zhíwù duì yǎnjing hǎo.) — Looking at green plants is good for eyes.
这双鞋子对我来说太大了。(Zhè shuāng xiézi duì wǒ láishuō tài dà le.) — These shoes are too big for me.
这件衣服有点小，有大号吗？(Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎn xiǎo, yǒu dà hào ma?) — This shirt is a bit small, do you have large size?
今天逛商场的人真多。(Jīntiān guàng shāngchǎng de rén zhēn duō.) — There are really so many people in the mall today.
今天来上课的学生比较少。(Jīntiān lái shàngkè de xuésheng bǐjiào shǎo.) — Relatively few students came to class today.
我想试穿一下这件外套。(Wǒ xiǎng shìchuān yíxià zhè jiàn wàitào.) — I would like to try on this jacket.

words.English Meaning: measure word for long / thin objects (pants, fish, roads)
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这条裤子款式很流行。(Zhè tiáo kùzi kuǎnshì hěn liúxíng.) — These pants have a very trendy style.
我可以试一试吗？(Wǒ kěyǐ shì yi shì ma?) — Can I try it on?
